name: Dawn Regalia (Draknara signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of {{PRIMARY}} woven cloth and soft hide with {{ACCENT_SOFT}} beadwork in bands and spirals, a fitted bodice with fringed {{METAL}} edging, a shoulder mantle of feathers and painted hide, and a skirt of layered fringe and woven panels that swings wide around her; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
